newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Jewish settlers position caravans in West Bank.
newsitem.headline: Jewish settlers position caravans in West Bank.

text.p: Jewish settlers placed mobile homes on a West Bank hilltop on Friday to try to expand a settlement in the Israeli-occupied territory, witnesses said.

A Reuters photographer said some 200 settlers positioned seven mobile homes at Beit El settlement near Palestinian-ruled Ramallah. He said several Israeli army jeeps were in the vicinity but did not intervene to stop the action.
Palestinian witnesses said the settlers moved in under the cover of darkness. They said the land belonged to the nearby Palestinian villages of Ein Yabrud, Dura al-Qare and Jilazoon.
Witnesses said the settlers moved in a refrigerator, generators and a children's jungle gym.
Beit El settlers last month laid the cornerstone of what they said was a new neighbourhood in the memory of a Jewish settler and her son who were gunned down by Arab guerrillas the previous week.
The move comes as Israeli and Palestinian peace teams are struggling to bridge remaining gaps and conclude a deal that would extend PLO self-rule to the West Bank town of Hebron.
